# Home Air Check

> > Home Air Check provides at-home air testing kits and lab analysis to detect indoor air contaminants including mold, VOCs, formaldehyde, dust, and smoke.

Home Air Check is an air quality testing service backed by Enthalpy Analytical that offers rental testing kits for comprehensive indoor air quality assessment. The platform helps homeowners identify common air pollutants and provides remediation guidance through lab analysis and expert resources.

## Key Topics

- Indoor Air Quality Testing
- Mold Detection & Testing
- Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs)
- Formaldehyde Testing
- Surface Dust Analysis
- Tobacco Smoke Detection
- Allergen Assessment
- Gas Chromatography-Mass Spectrometry
- Lab Analysis
- Air Remediation
- Home Health
- EPA Standards
- AIHA Certification
- Enthalpy Analytical
- Air Purification

## Testing Products & Kits

- [Indoor Air Testing Kits](https://www.homeaircheck.com/indoor-air-quality-testing): Product catalog of indoor air testing kits for VOCs, mold, formaldehyde, dust, and smoke detection
- [Comprehensive Test Kit - Surface Dust, VOCs, Mold, and Formaldehyde](https://www.homeaircheck.com/product/surface-dust-vocs-mold-formaldehyde): All-in-one air testing kit detecting dust, VOCs, mold, and formaldehyde with full lab analysis
- [Formaldehyde Testing Kit](https://www.homeaircheck.com/product/formaldehyde-test): Specialized formaldehyde detection kit with rental details and lab analysis
- [Tobacco Smoke Testing Kit](https://www.homeaircheck.com/product/tobacco-smoke-test): Detection kit for secondhand and thirdhand smoke exposure assessment
